hero.heading: AG Grid vs MUI X Data Grid
hero.subHeading: Compare AG Grid vs MUI X Data Grid on framework support, free and paid features, large datasets, pricing and licensing.

shortAnswer: AG Grid and MUI X Data Grid (the MUI DataGrid) both render a complete grid UI, and both have a free, MIT-licensed version and paid plans. AG Grid works with React, Angular, Vue and plain JavaScript; MUI X Data Grid is built for React only and needs Material UI as a peer dependency. The free version of AG Grid includes unlimited row virtualisation, column pinning and lazy loading from the server, which MUI X puts in its paid Pro plan. Row grouping, aggregation, pivoting and Excel export are paid in both: in [AG Grid Enterprise](/license-pricing/), a perpetual licence, and in MUI X Premium, sold per developer as an annual or a perpetual licence.

faq.question: Can I use AG Grid for free?
faq.answer: Yes. AG Grid Community is free and open source under the MIT licence, including for commercial use. AG Grid Enterprise is a paid licence that adds features such as row grouping, pivoting, Excel export and the Server-Side Row Model.

faq.question: Is MUI Data Grid Pro free?
faq.answer: No. MUI X Data Grid has a free, MIT-licensed Community version, but Pro is a paid plan, sold per developer as an annual or a perpetual licence. Row grouping, aggregation, pivoting and Excel export need the Premium plan.

faq.question: What is a Data Grid in MUI?
faq.answer: MUI X Data Grid is a React data grid component from MUI, the company behind Material UI. It is built for React only, uses Material UI for its styling, and comes in Community, Pro, Premium and Enterprise plans.

faq.question: Which React data grid is free?
faq.answer: AG Grid Community and the MUI X Data Grid Community version are both free under the MIT licence. In AG Grid Community, row virtualisation has no row limit, and column pinning and lazy loading from the server are included. In the free MUI X Data Grid, row virtualisation is limited to 100 rows, and column pinning and lazy loading need the Pro plan.

faq.question: Does MUI X Data Grid work with Angular or Vue?
faq.answer: No. MUI X Data Grid is built for React only. AG Grid supports React, Angular, Vue and plain JavaScript.

faq.question: Can I use AG Grid in a Material UI application?
faq.answer: Yes. AG Grid renders its own UI and does not depend on Material UI, so it works alongside it in a React application. Its built-in Material theme follows Google's Material Design v2, and the Theming API lets you set colours, fonts and spacing to match the rest of your application.
